meta.name: debug
meta.description: Investigate a failure, regression or incorrect result in an integration or application, even before it can be reproduced. Use for diagnosis and repair; follow incident authority for live mitigation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查清集成或应用里说不清的故障、回归与错误结果,找到根因并修好。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果联调或线上出现故障、回归或结果异常,需要找出根因并修复。
copy.tagline_en: Find and fix failures, regressions or wrong results you can't yet reproduce.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a failure, regression or odd result needs root-cause digging and repair.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按内置调试方法调查集成或应用里的故障、回归或错误结果,即使问题还没复现也能开始。它先读任务上下文契约和方法文档,再按需加载其他参考,给出诊断与修复方向。
howto.when: 当集成或应用出现故障、回归或错误结果、需要诊断修复时触发,即使尚未复现。线上止损仍遵循事件授权流程。

say.text: 这个接口有时返回错误结果,帮我查一下原因
say.note: 按调试方法排查并给出诊断

say.text: 有个回归问题还没复现,先帮我分析可能原因
按任务上下文契约和方法排查这个集成故障
say.note: 先读契约与方法再排查

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude investigates failures, regressions or wrong results in an integration or application with its built-in debug method, even before they can be reproduced, and reports a diagnosis.
howto.when_en: Triggers when an integration or application shows a failure, regression or wrong result and needs diagnosis or repair, even before it is reproduced. Live mitigation still follows incident authority.

say_en.text: This endpoint sometimes returns wrong results - find out why
We have a regression that won't reproduce yet; analyze likely causes
say_en.note: Starts the investigation without a repro

say_en.text: Debug this integration failure per the task context contract and method
say_en.note: Reads the contract and method first
